description.en: The autonomous system number (ASN) of the ECR instance. Valid values: 45104 (default), 64512 to 65534, and 4200000000 to 4294967294. The ASN 65025 is reserved for use by Alibaba Cloud.

description.zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

> 若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的**RequestId**作为**ClientToken**标识。每次API请求的**RequestId**不一样。
description.en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a value from your client and make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The \`ClientToken\` parameter supports only ASCII characters.

> If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the **RequestId** of the API request as the **ClientToken**. The **RequestId** may be different for each request.

description.zh:
专线网关实例的描述。

>描述可以为空或长度为 0～256 个字符，不能以 http://或 https://开头。
description.en:
The description of the ECR instance.

> The description can be empty or 0 to 256 characters in length. It cannot start with http\:// or https\://.

description.zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

- **true**：发送检查请求，不会修改服务资源。

- **false**（默认值）：发送正常请求。
description.en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

- **true**: sends a check request without modifying service resources.

- **false** (default): sends a normal request.

description.zh:
专线网关实例的名称。
> 名称可以为空或长度为 0～128 个字符，不能以 http://或 https://开头。
description.en:
The name of the ECR instance.

> The name can be empty or 0 to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with http\:// or https\://.

description.zh: 专线网关实例所属的资源组ID。
description.en: The ID of the resource group to which the ECR instance belongs.

description.zh:
标签。

最多可以绑定20个标签。
description.en:
The tags.

You can add up to 20 tags.

description.zh: 资源的标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en: The tag key. The key cannot be an empty string. The key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh: 监听的标签值。N的取值范围：**1**~**20**。一旦传入该值，可以为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en: The tag value. The value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length, cannot start with `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

descriptions.zh: 创建专线网关实例后，专线网关的实例状态为**Active**。
descriptions.en: After an Express Connect Router (ECR) instance is created, its status is **Active**.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun expressconnectrouter create-express-connect-router --name test --description test --resource-group-id rg-acfmvvajg5q0000 --alibaba-side-asn 45104 --dry-run false --client-token 02fb3da4-130e-11e9-8e44-000000 --tag Value=TestValue Key=TestKey --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun expressconnectrouter CreateExpressConnectRouter --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key TestKey --Description test --AlibabaSideAsn 45104 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmvvajg5q0000' --Tag.1.Value TestValue --DryRun false --ClientToken '02fb3da4-130e-11e9-8e44-000000' --Name test
